text: Developers can build their own app, agent, or bot that connects to a Capacities space as an MCP client using the Model Context Protocol
quote: Build your own app, agent, or bot and integrate it with a Capacities space by implementing a custom MCP client using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) open standard.

text: Chat Connectors link AI chat apps such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Le Chat to your Capacities space
quote: Chat Connectors let you connect AI chat apps, like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Le Chat, to your Capacities space.

text: The Capacities API uses token-based Bearer authentication (OAuth 2.0 RFC 6750)
quote: The Capacities API uses Bearer authentication (token-based authentication, OAuth 2.0 RFC 6750).

text: A REST API gives programmatic read and write access to objects, properties, block content, daily notes, and more
quote: The Capacities REST API gives you programmatic access to a workspace space — read and write objects, properties, block content, daily notes, and more.

text: An official TypeScript SDK is available as the npm package @capacities/api
quote: Install the Capacities TypeScript SDK: npm install @capacities/api

text: A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specification of the API can be downloaded
quote: Capacities publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at api.capacities.io/openapi.json: "openapi":"3.0.3", info title "Capacities API", version "1.0.0". The developer docs link it directly: "If you need programmatic access to the API sp

text: A hosted interactive API reference lets you add your token and make live requests
quote: The hosted reference at api.capacities.io/docs renders the OpenAPI document as an interactive dashboard with authenticated try-it: the spec's own description reads "Interactive **reference** for all routes of the Capacities API. You can add

text: The Beta API has a dated deprecation notice for September 1, 2026, with a successor API that covers versioning
quote: The developer docs carry a dated deprecation notice for the Beta API generation: "This is the documentation for the Capacities API Beta, which will be discontinued on **September 1, 2026**. The new Capacities API is available at developers.

text: API rate limits are documented per user per endpoint and exposed through RateLimit-Remaining response headers
quote: The developer docs carry a dated deprecation notice for the Beta API generation: "This is the documentation for the Capacities API Beta, which will be discontinued on **September 1, 2026**. The new Capacities API is available at developers.

text: AI can auto-fill the properties of custom objects using the model's knowledge
quote: AI Property Auto-Fill: Rather than manually filling in the properties of your custom objects, you can rely on the AI model's knowledge to auto-fill them for you.

text: AI picks relevant tags from your existing tags and assigns them to an object automatically
quote: AI identifies relevant tags from your existing tags and assigns them to that object.

text: AI image analysis extracts a title, description, OCR text (including handwriting), a color palette, and a category in one click
quote: AI Image Analysis: Analyze any image with one click. The AI extracts a title, description, text (OCR, including handwritten text), a color palette, and a category.

text: AI chats can be started from Explore or by keyboard shortcut, with blocks or notes passed in as context
quote: AI Chats: Start a chat with AI from Explore, or with a keyboard shortcut. You can pass blocks or notes as context.

text: The AI answers from your notes, plans multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve
quote: The AI answers based on your notes, can plan multi-step work, and can propose creates and updates for you to approve.

text: Selected blocks can be sent to an AI panel for translation, rewriting, or summarization
quote: After selecting blocks in your content, you can quickly launch the AI panel to perform tasks such as translation, rewriting, or summarization.

text: AI features are fully opt-in, and no space data goes to third-party AI services unless AI is activated
quote: AI features in Capacities are fully opt-in. If you do not activate AI, no data from your spaces is shared with any third-party AI services.

text: Version history lets you preview an object's earlier versions and restore them, for example after unwanted edits by an external assistant
quote: If an external assistant changes a note in a way you do not want, use Version history on that object to preview and restore an earlier version.

text: All backlinks to an object are grouped in a Backlinks section at the bottom of the object
quote: All backlinks are grouped together at the bottom of your object in a section titled "Backlinks".

text: Typing @ or [[ ]] links to existing content
quote: Use `@` or `[[]]` to link to existing content.

text: Individual blocks can be linked and referenced from other pages, with block search triggered by typing ((
quote: Capacities lets you link to individual blocks inside of an object, and reference them in other pages. We call this concept block-based linking or just block references.

text: Embedded blocks are identical to the original, so edits show up everywhere the block is used
quote: An embedded block is identical to the original. This means that any edits will occur in all places where this block is used.

text: Graph view shows the local neighbourhood of links around the open note
quote: Graph view shows how one object connects to others. Each link between notes becomes a line in the graph, so you can see the local neighbourhood around the note you have open.

text: Graphs can be opened on a collection, tag, query, object type dashboard, or extended search
quote: You can also open a graph on a collection, a tag, a query, an object type dashboard, or in extended search.

text: Each day has a daily note uniquely linked to it, for quick capture of ideas throughout the day
quote: A daily note is a note that is uniquely linked to one day. It often serves as a quick and simple way to write down ideas or things to remember as they occur throughout the day.

text: A daily note lists all references to that day, including date properties and mentions in your writing
quote: The next section shows all references of that day, including objects with properties to that day and mentions of the day in your writing.

text: The calendar offers Month, Week, Three days, and Day views
quote: The Calendar comes with four different views: "Month", "Week", "Three days", and "Day".

text: The Day view collects everything for a day, such as content created that day and links to specific times
quote: The "Day" view incorporates all available information for that day, such as content created on that day or links to a certain time.

text: Templates prefill an object's properties and blocks
quote: Templates allow you to prefill the content of an object- you can prefill properties and blocks in your objects.

text: Search returns useful results even when your wording is not exact
quote: Search in Capacities is designed to return useful results even when your wording is not exact.

text: Search works offline on all devices
quote: Search in Capacities is great for navigation, finding, and connecting your content. It works offline on all devices, giving you quick search results every time.

text: Actions and commands such as Open today or Create new page can be run from the search bar
quote: Execute actions and commands, like “Open today” or “Create new page”, using the search bar.

text: Cmd/Ctrl+U creates a new object
quote: You can use `Cmd U` (Mac) or `Ctrl U` (Windows) to create a new object

text: Full exports can be scheduled to run automatically
quote: You can schedule automatic exports by going to `Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule`.

text: Exports turn properties into front matter and collections into CSV files, readable by both humans and machines
quote: All your properties are transformed into front matter values, all collections are stored as CSV files, making it easy to reuse your content in other apps or work with it programmatically.

text: Offline-first app: you can work offline, and changes sync once you are back online
quote: Capacities is an offline-first application. You can work offline and your changes will get synchronized as soon as you're back online.

text: Content syncs across all devices
quote: Synchronization across all devices

text: All media files can be downloaded to the device for faster loading and offline viewing
quote: Capacities can also download all media files to your device so that they load faster and you can view them offline.

text: The mobile app is a companion to desktop for searching and capturing on the go
quote: The mobile app is a companion to desktop for day-to-day work in your space: search and capture on the go.

text: Notion content can be imported via a Markdown + CSV export and an in-app Notion migration guide
quote: Export selected content as Markdown + CSV... In Capacities, go to Settings > Import Content, open the Notion guide in Migration guides, then click Start

text: Bulk Import lets you review the mapping before importing Markdown + CSV exports in the desktop app
quote: Export selected content as Markdown + CSV. Review mapping in Bulk Import, then import in the Capacities desktop app.

text: Obsidian vaults can be imported, mapping types by folders or a YAML type field
quote: Choose a type-mapping method (folders or YAML `type`).

text: Evernote notebooks can be migrated via ENEX export converted to Markdown + media and mapped to object types
quote: Map notebooks to Capacities object types and properties. Export from Evernote (`ENEX` recommended). Convert each batch to Markdown + media.

text: Tana workspaces can be migrated by exporting as Markdown and mapping structure to object types and properties
quote: Map your Tana structure to Capacities object types and properties. Export your Tana workspace as Markdown.

text: Apple Notes folders can be mapped to object types as part of migration
quote: Map Apple Notes folders to Capacities object types.

text: Google Takeout and OneNote exports can be imported once you convert them to Markdown yourself
quote: You export from OneNote (usually as Word or PDF), turn those files into Markdown (and media), then import in the Capacities desktop app.

text: Built-in basic object types plus user-defined custom object types with properties
quote: Object types are either created automatically by Capacities, or you can create them yourself. The first group is what we call Basic Object Types, and the second are Custom Object Types.

text: Objects can be switched between types without lock-in to a single setup
quote: You can easily change between types so you never have to worry about being locked into a single setup.

text: Smart queries are offered
quote: Task management, AI assistant, Calendar integrations, Smart queries, Task actions

text: Task management with task actions is offered
quote: Task management, AI assistant, Calendar integrations, Smart queries, Task actions

text: Calendar integrations are offered
quote: Task management, AI assistant, Calendar integrations, Smart queries, Task actions

text: Notes can be shared with others as view-only
quote: Grant others view-only access to notes

text: Images become reusable image objects that can be used anywhere in a space
quote: Any image you input into Capacities becomes an image object, that can be reused anywhere in your space.

text: Content can be saved into Capacities from WhatsApp, Telegram, Twitter, or email
quote: Save content from WhatsApp, Telegram, Twitter, or via email

text: Bookmarks are saved as objects and can be linked to project notes
quote: Bookmark saved as an object and linked to your project notes.

text: Unlimited spaces, objects, and blocks
quote: Unlimited spaces, objects, and blocks
